decisions.decision: Repair of the Leominster Road stone directional marker with lettering repainted, brush cleared, and crushed gravel laid

topics.resolution: Reported as under construction for duplex conversion with townhouses planned
topics.quote: an update from the building inspector regarding 763 ma ave reports that the building is under construction to be converted to a duplex. this will be followed by two additional townhouses being built on the front lot.

topics.quote: todd holman of the dpw reported that no response has been received from the owner of the arnold litch property. they do have plans to begin digging for the wall at the goodrich cemetery starting next week.
